(* ===================================================================================== *)
(* 2.0 TRIPLE MODULAR REDUNDANCY (2oo3 TMR) SENSOR VOTING ALGORITHMS                    *)
(* ===================================================================================== *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* 2.1 UV-280nm Multi-Channel Absorbance Voting & Drift Screening                        *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Out-of-Range Screening: Optical Range [-50.0 mAU .. 3500.0 mAU] *)
bUV280_ChA_Healthy := (rUV280_SensA_mAU >= -50.0) AND (rUV280_SensA_mAU <= 3500.0);
bUV280_ChB_Healthy := (rUV280_SensB_mAU >= -50.0) AND (rUV280_SensB_mAU <= 3500.0);
bUV280_ChC_Healthy := (rUV280_SensC_mAU >= -50.0) AND (rUV280_SensC_mAU <= 3500.0);

rDiffUV_AB := ABS(rUV280_SensA_mAU - rUV280_SensB_mAU);
rDiffUV_BC := ABS(rUV280_SensB_mAU - rUV280_SensC_mAU);
rDiffUV_CA := ABS(rUV280_SensC_mAU - rUV280_SensA_mAU);

(* 2oo3 Median Selection when All 3 Channels are Healthy *)
IF bUV280_ChA_Healthy AND bUV280_ChB_Healthy AND bUV280_ChC_Healthy THEN
    bUV280_Degraded_1oo2 := FALSE;
    IF (rUV280_SensA_mAU >= rUV280_SensB_mAU AND rUV280_SensA_mAU <= rUV280_SensC_mAU) OR
       (rUV280_SensA_mAU >= rUV280_SensC_mAU AND rUV280_SensA_mAU <= rUV280_SensB_mAU) THEN
        rVoted_UV280_mAU := rUV280_SensA_mAU;
    ELSIF (rUV280_SensB_mAU >= rUV280_SensA_mAU AND rUV280_SensB_mAU <= rUV280_SensC_mAU) OR
          (rUV280_SensB_mAU >= rUV280_SensC_mAU AND rUV280_SensB_mAU <= rUV280_SensA_mAU) THEN
        rVoted_UV280_mAU := rUV280_SensB_mAU;
    ELSE
        rVoted_UV280_mAU := rUV280_SensC_mAU;
    END_IF;
    (* Cross-Channel Drift Screening: Flag if discrepancy > 75.0 mAU *)
    IF (rDiffUV_AB > 75.0) OR (rDiffUV_BC > 75.0) OR (rDiffUV_CA > 75.0) THEN
        dwAlarmWord_2 := dwAlarmWord_2 OR 16#0000_0001; (* UV Sensor Drift Warning *)
    END_IF;
(* Degraded 1oo2 Voting on Single Channel Failure *)
ELSIF bUV280_ChA_Healthy AND bUV280_ChB_Healthy THEN
    bUV280_Degraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
    rVoted_UV280_mAU     := 0.5 * (rUV280_SensA_mAU + rUV280_SensB_mAU);
    dwAlarmWord_2        := dwAlarmWord_2 OR 16#0000_0002; (* UV Ch C Failed - 1oo2 Degraded *)
ELSIF bUV280_ChB_Healthy AND bUV280_ChC_Healthy THEN
    bUV280_Degraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
    rVoted_UV280_mAU     := 0.5 * (rUV280_SensB_mAU + rUV280_SensC_mAU);
    dwAlarmWord_2        := dwAlarmWord_2 OR 16#0000_0004; (* UV Ch A Failed - 1oo2 Degraded *)
ELSIF bUV280_ChC_Healthy AND bUV280_ChA_Healthy THEN
    bUV280_Degraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
    rVoted_UV280_mAU     := 0.5 * (rUV280_SensC_mAU + rUV280_SensA_mAU);
    dwAlarmWord_2        := dwAlarmWord_2 OR 16#0000_0008; (* UV Ch B Failed - 1oo2 Degraded *)
(* 2 Channels Failed - Emergency Fallback to Short-Path UV-300nm *)
ELSIF bUV280_ChA_Healthy THEN
    rVoted_UV280_mAU     := rUV280_SensA_mAU;
    dwAlarmWord_1        := dwAlarmWord_1 OR 16#0000_0002; (* Critical UV TMR Loss *)
ELSIF bUV280_ChB_Healthy THEN
    rVoted_UV280_mAU     := rUV280_SensB_mAU;
    dwAlarmWord_1        := dwAlarmWord_1 OR 16#0000_0002;
ELSIF bUV280_ChC_Healthy THEN
    rVoted_UV280_mAU     := rUV280_SensC_mAU;
    dwAlarmWord_1        := dwAlarmWord_1 OR 16#0000_0002;
ELSE
    (* Complete Loss of Primary UV-280nm: Synthesize proxy from UV-300nm (Pathlength Factor ~ 4.8) *)
    rVoted_UV280_mAU     := rUV300_Sens_mAU * 4.80;
    dwAlarmWord_1        := dwAlarmWord_1 OR 16#0000_0004; (* Total UV-280 Hardware Failure *)
    bDegradedControlActive := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* 2.2 Pre-Column Inlet Hydraulic Pressure Transducer 2oo3 Voting                        *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
bPress_ChA_Healthy := (rPressPreCol_SensA_bar >= -0.2) AND (rPressPreCol_SensA_bar <= 8.0);
bPress_ChB_Healthy := (rPressPreCol_SensB_bar >= -0.2) AND (rPressPreCol_SensB_bar <= 8.0);
bPress_ChC_Healthy := (rPressPreCol_SensC_bar >= -0.2) AND (rPressPreCol_SensC_bar <= 8.0);

rDiffPress_BC := ABS(rPressPreCol_SensB_bar - rPressPreCol_SensC_bar);
rDiffPress_CA := ABS(rPressPreCol_SensC_bar - rPressPreCol_SensA_bar);

IF bPress_ChA_Healthy AND bPress_ChB_Healthy AND bPress_ChC_Healthy THEN
    bPress_Degraded_1oo2 := FALSE;
    IF (rPressPreCol_SensA_bar >= rPressPreCol_SensB_bar AND rPressPreCol_SensA_bar <= rPressPreCol_SensC_bar) OR
       (rPressPreCol_SensA_bar >= rPressPreCol_SensC_bar AND rPressPreCol_SensA_bar <= rPressPreCol_SensB_bar) THEN

    ELSIF (rPressPreCol_SensB_bar >= rPressPreCol_SensA_bar AND rPressPreCol_SensB_bar <= rPressPreCol_SensC_bar) OR
          (rPressPreCol_SensB_bar >= rPressPreCol_SensC_bar AND rPressPreCol_SensB_bar <= rPressPreCol_SensA_bar) THEN
        rVoted_PressPreCol_bar := rPressPreCol_SensB_bar;
    ELSE
        rVoted_PressPreCol_bar := rPressPreCol_SensC_bar;
    END_IF;
    IF (rDiffPress_AB > 0.45) OR (rDiffPress_BC > 0.45) OR (rDiffPress_CA > 0.45) THEN
        dwAlarmWord_2 := dwAlarmWord_2 OR 16#0000_0010; (* Pressure Sensor Discrepancy Warning *)
    END_IF;
ELSIF bPress_ChA_Healthy AND bPress_ChB_Healthy THEN
    bPress_Degraded_1oo2   := TRUE;
    rVoted_PressPreCol_bar := 0.5 * (rPressPreCol_SensA_bar + rPressPreCol_SensB_bar);

    dwAlarmWord_2          := dwAlarmWord_2 OR 16#0000_0080; (* Press Ch B Failed - 1oo2 Degraded *)

    IF bPress_ChA_Healthy THEN rVoted_PressPreCol_bar := rPressPreCol_SensA_bar;
    ELSIF bPress_ChB_Healthy THEN rVoted_PressPreCol_bar := rPressPreCol_SensB_bar;
    ELSIF bPress_ChC_Healthy THEN rVoted_PressPreCol_bar := rPressPreCol_SensC_bar;
    ELSE rVoted_PressPreCol_bar := 6.0; (* Fail-safe artificial high pressure *)
    END_IF;
    dwAlarmWord_1          := dwAlarmWord_1 OR 16#0000_0008; (* Critical Pressure TMR Loss *)

    IF (rDiffCond_AB > 3.5) OR (rDiffCond_BC > 3.5) OR (rDiffCond_CA > 3.5) THEN

    END_IF;
ELSIF bCond_ChA_Healthy AND bCond_ChB_Healthy THEN

    rVoted_Cond_mScm    := 0.5 * (rCond_SensB_mScm + rCond_SensC_mScm);

    rVoted_FeedFlow_mLmin := rFeedFlow_SensB_mLmin;
ELSE
    rVoted_FeedFlow_mLmin := rFeedFlow_SensC_mLmin;
END_IF;

(* ===================================================================================== *)
(* 3.0 DIGITAL EXPONENTIAL FILTERING & PROCESS HYDRAULIC MODELING                       *)
(* ===================================================================================== *)
(* 1st-Order Recursive Exponential Smoothing *)
rFilteredFeedFlow_mLmin   := (rFilterAlpha_Flow * rVoted_FeedFlow_mLmin) + ((1.0 - rFilterAlpha_Flow) * rFilteredFeedFlow_mLmin);
rFilteredEluentFlow_mLmin := (rFilterAlpha_Flow * rEluentFlow_Sens_mLmin) + ((1.0 - rFilterAlpha_Flow) * rFilteredEluentFlow_mLmin);
rFilteredWashFlow_mLmin   := (rFilterAlpha_Flow * rWashFlow_Sens_mLmin) + ((1.0 - rFilterAlpha_Flow) * rFilteredWashFlow_mLmin);
rFilteredCIPFlow_mLmin    := (rFilterAlpha_Flow * rCIPFlow_Sens_mLmin) + ((1.0 - rFilterAlpha_Flow) * rFilteredCIPFlow_mLmin);
rFilteredPressPreCol_bar  := (rFilterAlpha_Press * rVoted_PressPreCol_bar) + ((1.0 - rFilterAlpha_Press) * rFilteredPressPreCol_bar);
rFilteredPressPostCol_bar := (rFilterAlpha_Press * rPressPostCol_bar) + ((1.0 - rFilterAlpha_Press) * rFilteredPressPostCol_bar);
rFilteredUV280_mAU        := (rFilterAlpha_UV * rVoted_UV280_mAU) + ((1.0 - rFilterAlpha_UV) * rFilteredUV280_mAU);
rFilteredUV254_mAU        := (rFilterAlpha_UV * rUV254_Sens_mAU) + ((1.0 - rFilterAlpha_UV) * rFilteredUV254_mAU);
rFilteredUV300_mAU        := (rFilterAlpha_UV * rUV300_Sens_mAU) + ((1.0 - rFilterAlpha_UV) * rFilteredUV300_mAU);
rFilteredCond_mScm        := (rFilterAlpha_Cond * rVoted_Cond_mScm) + ((1.0 - rFilterAlpha_Cond) * rFilteredCond_mScm);
rFilteredAmbientTemp_degC := (0.05 * rAmbientTemp_degC) + (0.95 * rFilteredAmbientTemp_degC);

(* Column Differential Hydraulic Pressure *)
rColumnDeltaP_bar := rFilteredPressPreCol_bar - rFilteredPressPostCol_bar;
IF rColumnDeltaP_bar < 0.0 THEN
    rColumnDeltaP_bar := 0.0; (* Negative delta-P clamp *)
END_IF;

(* Column Dimensional Geometry & Fluid Velocity Computations *)
IF rColumnDiameter_mm < 5.0 THEN rColumnDiameter_mm := 26.0; END_IF; (* Standard 26 mm ID default *)
IF rResinBedHeight_mm < 20.0 THEN rResinBedHeight_mm := 100.0; END_IF; (* Standard 100 mm bed length *)

(* Area = pi * (D/2)^2 in cm^2: D in mm -> radius in cm = (D / 20.0) *)
rColumnCrossSection_cm2 := 3.14159265 * (rColumnDiameter_mm / 20.0) * (rColumnDiameter_mm / 20.0);
rColumnVolume_CV_mL     := rColumnCrossSection_cm2 * (rResinBedHeight_mm / 10.0);
rTotalCarouselVolume_mL := rColumnVolume_CV_mL * 8.0;
rSafetyFrontLimit_mm    := 0.85 * rResinBedHeight_mm; (* 85% bed length threshold *)

(* Linear Superfacial & Interstitial Velocity [cm/hour] *)
IF rColumnCrossSection_cm2 > 0.1 THEN
    (* Flow in mL/min = cm^3/min -> cm^3/h = Flow * 60.0. Linear velocity u_s = Flow*60 / Area *)
    rInterstitialVelocity_cm_h := (rFilteredFeedFlow_mLmin * 60.0) / (rColumnCrossSection_cm2 * rResinBedPorosity_eps_b);
ELSE
    rInterstitialVelocity_cm_h := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Darcy / Blake-Kozeny Differential Pressure Formulation *)
(* Delta_P = 150 * mu * u * L * (1 - eps_b)^2 / (dp^2 * eps_b^3) *)
(* Fluid viscosity temperature correction: mu(T) = mu_20 * exp(-0.023 * (T - 20)) *)
rFluidViscosity_mPas := 1.002 * EXP(-0.023 * (rFilteredAmbientTemp_degC - 20.0));
IF rFluidViscosity_mPas < 0.5 THEN rFluidViscosity_mPas := 0.5; END_IF;

rBlakeKozenyDeltaP_bar := (150.0 * (rFluidViscosity_mPas * 1.0E-3) * ((rInterstitialVelocity_cm_h / 3600.0) * 1.0E-2) *
                           (rResinBedHeight_mm * 1.0E-3) * ((1.0 - rResinBedPorosity_eps_b) * (1.0 - rResinBedPorosity_eps_b))) /
                          ((85.0E-6 * 85.0E-6) * (rResinBedPorosity_eps_b * rResinBedPorosity_eps_b * rResinBedPorosity_eps_b) * 1.0E5);

(* Bed Compaction Loss & Fouling Hysteresis Tracking *)
IF rBlakeKozenyDeltaP_bar > 0.05 THEN
    rResinBedCompressionFactor := rColumnDeltaP_bar / rBlakeKozenyDeltaP_bar;
    IF rResinBedCompressionFactor > 2.25 THEN
        bBedCompactionWarning := TRUE;
        dwAlarmWord_3 := dwAlarmWord_3 OR 16#0000_0001; (* Bed Compaction / Permeability Loss *)
    ELSE
        bBedCompactionWarning := FALSE;
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(* Critical Hydraulic Pressure Trips *)
tonOverpressureTrip(IN := (rColumnDeltaP_bar >= 4.80) OR (rFilteredPressPreCol_bar >= 5.50), PT := T#1500MS);
IF tonOverpressureTrip.Q THEN
    dwAlarmWord_1 := dwAlarmWord_1 OR 16#0000_0020; (* Column Overpressure Burst Protection Trip *)
    iState := 99; (* EMERGENCY SHUTDOWN *)
END_IF;

(* Air Bubble Ultrasonic Trip Debounce *)
tonBubbleDebounce(IN := bAirBubbleDetected, PT := T#250MS);
IF tonBubbleDebounce.Q THEN
    dwAlarmWord_3 := dwAlarmWord_3 OR 16#0000_0002; (* Air Bubble In Feed Line Trip *)
    iState := 99; (* Halt Immediately to Prevent Resin Bed Dewetting *)
END_IF;

(* ===================================================================================== *)
(* 4.0 THOMAS KINETIC ADSORPTION & RESIN BINDING CAPACITY FRONT TRACKING                 *)
(* ===================================================================================== *)
(* Integrate Feed Mass onto Lead Column during Active Capture (State 40) *)
IF (iState = 40) AND (rFilteredFeedFlow_mLmin > 0.5) AND (rFeedTiter_mg_mL > 0.01) THEN
    (* dVol = Flow [mL/min] * (dt [ms] / 60000.0) [min] *)
    rCumulativeFeedVolume_mL := rCumulativeFeedVolume_mL + (rFilteredFeedFlow_mLmin * (tScanCycleTime_ms / 60000.0));
    rCumulativeMassLoaded_mg := rCumulativeFeedVolume_mL * rFeedTiter_mg_mL;
END_IF;

(* Total Column Equilibrium Static Binding Capacity [mg] *)
(* Q_max_column = q_0 [mg/mL] * ColumnVolume [mL] *)
rResinRemainingCapacity_mg := (rResinStaticCapacity_q0_mg_mL * rColumnVolume_CV_mL) - rCumulativeMassLoaded_mg;
IF rResinRemainingCapacity_mg < 0.0 THEN
    rResinRemainingCapacity_mg := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Lead Column Remaining Capacity Percentage [%] *)
IF (rResinStaticCapacity_q0_mg_mL * rColumnVolume_CV_mL) > 1.0 THEN
    rResinBindingCapacityRem_pct := (rResinRemainingCapacity_mg / (rResinStaticCapacity_q0_mg_mL * rColumnVolume_CV_mL)) * 100.0;
ELSE
    rResinBindingCapacityRem_pct := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Thomas Kinetic Non-Linear Breakthrough Model Equation:                                 *)
(*   Arg = (k_Th / Q_feed) * (q_0 * V_col - C_0 * V_feed)                                 *)
(*   C/C0 = 1.0 / (1.0 + exp(Arg))                                                       *)
IF (rFilteredFeedFlow_mLmin > 1.0) AND (rFeedTiter_mg_mL > 0.05) THEN
    VAR_TEMP
        rThomasArg : REAL;
    END_VAR
    rThomasArg := (rThomasRateConst_kTh / rFilteredFeedFlow_mLmin) *
                  ((rResinStaticCapacity_q0_mg_mL * rColumnVolume_CV_mL) - (rFeedTiter_mg_mL * rCumulativeFeedVolume_mL));
    (* Numerical clamp on exponential argument to prevent floating-point overflow *)
    IF rThomasArg > 35.0 THEN rThomasArg := 35.0; END_IF;
    IF rThomasArg < -35.0 THEN rThomasArg := -35.0; END_IF;
    rInstantaneousC_over_C0 := 1.0 / (1.0 + EXP(rThomasArg));
ELSE
    rInstantaneousC_over_C0 := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Estimate Breakthrough Front Axial Location z_f [mm] *)
(* When C/C0 reaches 0.5, front is centered at L/2. Normalized progression: *)
IF (rResinStaticCapacity_q0_mg_mL * rColumnVolume_CV_mL) > 0.1 THEN
    rBreakthroughFront_mm := rResinBedHeight_mm * (rCumulativeMassLoaded_mg / (rResinStaticCapacity_q0_mg_mL * rColumnVolume_CV_mL));
ELSE
    rBreakthroughFront_mm := 0.0;
END_IF;
IF rBreakthroughFront_mm > rResinBedHeight_mm THEN
    rBreakthroughFront_mm := rResinBedHeight_mm;
END_IF;
rBindingFrontPosition_mm := rBreakthroughFront_mm;

(* Safety Breakthrough Warning when front penetrates beyond 85% of Bed Depth *)
IF rBindingFrontPosition_mm >= rSafetyFrontLimit_mm THEN
    dwAlarmWord_2 := dwAlarmWord_2 OR 16#0000_1000; (* Dynamic Binding Front Overrun Warning *)
END_IF;

(* ===================================================================================== *)
(* 5.0 UV-280nm PEAK DECONVOLUTION & REAL-TIME MOMENTS ADAPTIVE ZONE SHIFTING            *)
(* ===================================================================================== *)
(* Compute Numerical Time Derivatives of Voted UV-280nm Absorbance *)
(* dt in seconds = tScanCycleTime_ms / 1000.0 *)
IF tScanCycleTime_ms > 0.1 THEN
    rdUV_dt   := (rFilteredUV280_mAU - rUV280_Prev1_mAU) / (tScanCycleTime_ms / 1000.0);
    rd2UV_dt2 := (rdUV_dt - ((rUV280_Prev1_mAU - rUV280_Prev2_mAU) / (tScanCycleTime_ms / 1000.0))) / (tScanCycleTime_ms / 1000.0);
END_IF;
rUV280_Prev2_mAU := rUV280_Prev1_mAU;
rUV280_Prev1_mAU := rFilteredUV280_mAU;

(* Low-pass filter derivatives to eliminate optical vibration noise *)
rdUV_dt_Filtered   := (0.25 * rdUV_dt) + (0.75 * rdUV_dt_Filtered);
rd2UV_dt2_Filtered := (0.20 * rd2UV_dt2) + (0.80 * rd2UV_dt2_Filtered);

(* Running Baseline Tracking outside elution window *)
IF (NOT bPeakActiveWindow) AND (rFilteredUV280_mAU < 60.0) THEN
    rUV_Baseline_mAU := (0.01 * rFilteredUV280_mAU) + (0.99 * rUV_Baseline_mAU);
END_IF;

(* Chromatographic Peak Onset Detection Logic *)
IF (NOT bPeakActiveWindow) AND (rFilteredUV280_mAU > (rUV_Baseline_mAU + 25.0)) AND (rdUV_dt_Filtered > rSlopeStartThreshold) THEN
    bPeakActiveWindow           := TRUE;
    rPeakStartTime_s            := rCycleTimer_s;
    rPeakApex_mAU               := rFilteredUV280_mAU;
    rPeakArea_Total_mAU_s       := 0.0;
    rPeakFirstMoment_Num        := 0.0;
    rPeakSecondMoment_Num       := 0.0;
    rHeartCutMonomerArea_mAU_s  := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Active Peak Integration & Statistical Moment Accumulation *)
IF bPeakActiveWindow THEN
    VAR_TEMP
        rScanDt_s : REAL;
        rNetUV    : REAL;
    END_VAR
    rScanDt_s := tScanCycleTime_ms / 1000.0;
    rNetUV    := rFilteredUV280_mAU - rUV_Baseline_mAU;
    IF rNetUV < 0.0 THEN rNetUV := 0.0; END_IF;

    (* Peak Apex Tracking *)
    IF rFilteredUV280_mAU > rPeakApex_mAU THEN
        rPeakApex_mAU := rFilteredUV280_mAU;
    END_IF;

    (* Trapezoidal Integration of Zeroth, First, and Second Moments *)
    rPeakArea_Total_mAU_s := rPeakArea_Total_mAU_s + (rNetUV * rScanDt_s);
    rPeakFirstMoment_Num  := rPeakFirstMoment_Num + (rCycleTimer_s * rNetUV * rScanDt_s);

    (* Real-Time Peak Centroid mu [s] *)
    IF rPeakArea_Total_mAU_s > 1.0 THEN
        rPeakMeanCentroid_s := rPeakFirstMoment_Num / rPeakArea_Total_mAU_s;
    END_IF;

    (* Dynamic Cut-Point Identification for Center-Cut Monomer Harvest *)
    (* High-Molecular Weight Aggregates (HMWS) elute on leading edge: cut after positive inflection *)
    rAggregateLeadingCut_s := rPeakStartTime_s + 22.0;
    (* Low-Molecular Weight Fragments (LMWS) elute on tail: cut before baseline return *)
    rFragmentTrailingCut_s := rPeakMeanCentroid_s + 45.0;

    (* Diverter Valve Control: Collect Pure Heart-Cut Monomer *)
    IF (rCycleTimer_s >= rAggregateLeadingCut_s) AND (rCycleTimer_s <= rFragmentTrailingCut_s) AND
       (rFilteredUV280_mAU >= 120.0) AND (rFilteredUV254_mAU / (rFilteredUV280_mAU + 0.01) < 0.65) THEN
        bActiveElutionCut := TRUE;  (* Route to Target mAb Bulk Harvest Tank *)
        bActiveRecycleCut := FALSE;
        rHeartCutMonomerArea_mAU_s := rHeartCutMonomerArea_mAU_s + (rNetUV * rScanDt_s);
    ELSIF (rFilteredUV280_mAU >= 65.0) THEN
        bActiveElutionCut := FALSE;
        bActiveRecycleCut := TRUE;  (* Recycle Front/Tail Cuts Back into MCSGP Zone II *)
    ELSE
        bActiveElutionCut := FALSE;
        bActiveRecycleCut := FALSE; (* Route Solvent Waste to Raffinate Header *)
    END_IF;

    (* Peak Termination Condition: Fall below threshold with negative slope *)
    IF (rCycleTimer_s > (rPeakStartTime_s + 40.0)) AND
       ((rFilteredUV280_mAU <= (rUV_Baseline_mAU + 20.0)) OR (rCycleTimer_s >= rCycleStepTimeSetpt_s - 10.0)) THEN
        bPeakActiveWindow   := FALSE;
        rPeakEndTime_s      := rCycleTimer_s;
        rPeakDuration_s     := rPeakEndTime_s - rPeakStartTime_s;
        bActiveElutionCut   := FALSE;
        bActiveRecycleCut   := FALSE;

        (* Deconvoluted Main Peak Monomer Fraction Percentage *)
        IF rPeakArea_Total_mAU_s > 5.0 THEN
            rDeconvolutedMonomerFrac_pct := (rHeartCutMonomerArea_mAU_s / rPeakArea_Total_mAU_s) * 100.0;
        ELSE
            rDeconvolutedMonomerFrac_pct := 95.0; (* Default assumption *)
        END_IF;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    bActiveElutionCut := FALSE;
    bActiveRecycleCut := FALSE;
END_IF;

(* Compute Peak Retention Centroid Error & Export Metrics *)
rPeakCentroidTime_s := rPeakMeanCentroid_s;
rCentroidError_s    := rPeakMeanCentroid_s - rTargetElutionCentroid_s;

(* Adaptive Rotary Step-Time Correction: Shift switching interval to re-center elution window *)
rAdaptedStepTime_s := rCycleStepTimeSetpt_s + (0.35 * rCentroidError_s);
IF rAdaptedStepTime_s > rStepTime_Max_s THEN rAdaptedStepTime_s := rStepTime_Max_s; END_IF;
IF rAdaptedStepTime_s < rStepTime_Min_s THEN rAdaptedStepTime_s := rStepTime_Min_s; END_IF;

(* ===================================================================================== *)
(* 6.0 STATE-SPACE MODEL & MODEL PREDICTIVE CONTROL (MPC) QUADRATIC PROGRAMMING          *)
(* ===================================================================================== *)
(* Update Current State Vector Errors *)
x1_FrontPosErr_mm    := rBindingFrontPosition_mm - (0.50 * rResinBedHeight_mm);
x2_CentroidErr_s     := rCentroidError_s;
x3_DeltaPressErr_bar := rColumnDeltaP_bar - 2.20; (* Baseline target 2.20 bar *)
x4_CondErr_mScm      := rFilteredCond_mScm - 18.5; (* Baseline elution buffer target 18.5 mS/cm *)
x5_PurityErr_pct     := 98.5 - rDeconvolutedMonomerFrac_pct; (* Target 98.5% monomer purity *)
x6_AngleErr_deg      := rEncoderError_deg;

(* Compute One-Step Forward State Prediction: x_Next = Ad * x + Bd * u_prev *)
x1_Next := (Ad_11 * x1_FrontPosErr_mm) + (Ad_12 * x2_CentroidErr_s) + (Ad_13 * x3_DeltaPressErr_bar) +
           (Ad_14 * x4_CondErr_mScm) + (Ad_15 * x5_PurityErr_pct) + (Ad_16 * x6_AngleErr_deg);

x2_Next := (Ad_21 * x1_FrontPosErr_mm) + (Ad_22 * x2_CentroidErr_s) + (Ad_23 * x3_DeltaPressErr_bar) +
           (Ad_24 * x4_CondErr_mScm) + (Ad_25 * x5_PurityErr_pct) + (Ad_26 * x6_AngleErr_deg);

x3_Next := (Ad_31 * x1_FrontPosErr_mm) + (Ad_32 * x2_CentroidErr_s) + (Ad_33 * x3_DeltaPressErr_bar) +
           (Ad_34 * x4_CondErr_mScm) + (Ad_35 * x5_PurityErr_pct) + (Ad_36 * x6_AngleErr_deg);

x4_Next := (Ad_41 * x1_FrontPosErr_mm) + (Ad_42 * x2_CentroidErr_s) + (Ad_43 * x3_DeltaPressErr_bar) +
           (Ad_44 * x4_CondErr_mScm) + (Ad_45 * x5_PurityErr_pct) + (Ad_46 * x6_AngleErr_deg);

x5_Next := (Ad_51 * x1_FrontPosErr_mm) + (Ad_52 * x2_CentroidErr_s) + (Ad_53 * x3_DeltaPressErr_bar) +
           (Ad_54 * x4_CondErr_mScm) + (Ad_55 * x5_PurityErr_pct) + (Ad_56 * x6_AngleErr_deg);

x6_Next := (Ad_61 * x1_FrontPosErr_mm) + (Ad_62 * x2_CentroidErr_s) + (Ad_63 * x3_DeltaPressErr_bar) +
           (Ad_64 * x4_CondErr_mScm) + (Ad_65 * x5_PurityErr_pct) + (Ad_66 * x6_AngleErr_deg);

(* Real-Time Quadratic Cost Function Hessian Elements: H = Bd^T * Q * Bd + R *)
rHess_11 := (Bd_11 * Bd_11 * rMPC_Weight_FrontPos) + (Bd_21 * Bd_21 * rMPC_Weight_Centroid) +
            (Bd_31 * Bd_31 * rMPC_Weight_DeltaP)   + (Bd_51 * Bd_51 * rMPC_Weight_Purity) + rMPC_Weight_dFeedFlow;

rHess_22 := (Bd_12 * Bd_12 * rMPC_Weight_FrontPos) + (Bd_22 * Bd_22 * rMPC_Weight_Centroid) +
            (Bd_32 * Bd_32 * rMPC_Weight_DeltaP)   + (Bd_52 * Bd_52 * rMPC_Weight_Purity) + rMPC_Weight_dEluFlow;

rHess_33 := (Bd_13 * Bd_13 * rMPC_Weight_FrontPos) + (Bd_23 * Bd_23 * rMPC_Weight_Centroid) +
            (Bd_33 * Bd_33 * rMPC_Weight_DeltaP)   + (Bd_53 * Bd_53 * rMPC_Weight_Purity) + rMPC_Weight_dStepTime;

rHess_44 := (Bd_14 * Bd_14 * rMPC_Weight_FrontPos) + (Bd_24 * Bd_24 * rMPC_Weight_Centroid) +
            (Bd_44 * Bd_44 * rMPC_Weight_Conductivity) + (Bd_54 * Bd_54 * rMPC_Weight_Purity) + rMPC_Weight_dBufferB;

rHess_12 := (Bd_11 * Bd_12 * rMPC_Weight_FrontPos) + (Bd_21 * Bd_22 * rMPC_Weight_Centroid) +
            (Bd_31 * Bd_32 * rMPC_Weight_DeltaP)   + (Bd_51 * Bd_52 * rMPC_Weight_Purity);
rHess_21 := rHess_12;

rHess_13 := (Bd_11 * Bd_13 * rMPC_Weight_FrontPos) + (Bd_21 * Bd_23 * rMPC_Weight_Centroid) +
            (Bd_31 * Bd_33 * rMPC_Weight_DeltaP)   + (Bd_51 * Bd_53 * rMPC_Weight_Purity);
rHess_31 := rHess_13;

rHess_23 := (Bd_12 * Bd_13 * rMPC_Weight_FrontPos) + (Bd_22 * Bd_23 * rMPC_Weight_Centroid) +
            (Bd_32 * Bd_33 * rMPC_Weight_DeltaP)   + (Bd_52 * Bd_53 * rMPC_Weight_Purity);
rHess_32 := rHess_23;

rHess_24 := (Bd_22 * Bd_24 * rMPC_Weight_Centroid) + (Bd_52 * Bd_54 * rMPC_Weight_Purity);
rHess_42 := rHess_24;

(* Compute Cost Gradients: g = Bd^T * Q * x_Next *)
rGrad_1 := (Bd_11 * rMPC_Weight_FrontPos * x1_Next) + (Bd_21 * rMPC_Weight_Centroid * x2_Next) +
           (Bd_31 * rMPC_Weight_DeltaP * x3_Next)   + (Bd_51 * rMPC_Weight_Purity * x5_Next);

rGrad_2 := (Bd_12 * rMPC_Weight_FrontPos * x1_Next) + (Bd_22 * rMPC_Weight_Centroid * x2_Next) +
           (Bd_32 * rMPC_Weight_DeltaP * x3_Next)   + (Bd_52 * rMPC_Weight_Purity * x5_Next);

rGrad_3 := (Bd_13 * rMPC_Weight_FrontPos * x1_Next) + (Bd_23 * rMPC_Weight_Centroid * x2_Next) +
           (Bd_33 * rMPC_Weight_DeltaP * x3_Next)   + (Bd_53 * rMPC_Weight_Purity * x5_Next);

rGrad_4 := (Bd_24 * rMPC_Weight_Centroid * x2_Next) + (Bd_44 * rMPC_Weight_Conductivity * x4_Next) +
           (Bd_54 * rMPC_Weight_Purity * x5_Next);

(* Barrier Penalties for Pressure Ceiling (4.5 bar) and Breakthrough Depth (80% bed) *)
IF rColumnDeltaP_bar > 3.80 THEN
    rBarrierSlackPressure := (rColumnDeltaP_bar - 3.80) * 45.0;
    rGrad_1 := rGrad_1 + (rBarrierSlackPressure * 0.85); (* Strong feed throttle *)
    rGrad_2 := rGrad_2 + (rBarrierSlackPressure * 0.50); (* Eluent throttle *)
END_IF;

IF rBindingFrontPosition_mm > (0.75 * rResinBedHeight_mm) THEN
    rBarrierSlackFront := (rBindingFrontPosition_mm - (0.75 * rResinBedHeight_mm)) * 30.0;
    rGrad_1 := rGrad_1 + rBarrierSlackFront; (* Reduce feed loading *)
    rGrad_3 := rGrad_3 - (rBarrierSlackFront * 0.75); (* Accelerate rotary step *)
END_IF;

(* Projected Gradient Step: Delta_u = - H_inv * g (Approximated with diagonal relaxation) *)
IF (rHess_11 > 0.01) AND (rHess_22 > 0.01) AND (rHess_33 > 0.01) AND (rHess_44 > 0.01) THEN
    bMPC_IllConditioned := FALSE;
    rDelta_u1_FeedFlow   := - (rGrad_1 / rHess_11) * rMPCStepSize;
    rDelta_u2_EluentFlow := - (rGrad_2 / rHess_22) * rMPCStepSize;
    rDelta_u3_StepTime   := - (rGrad_3 / rHess_33) * rMPCStepSize;
    rDelta_u4_BufferB    := - (rGrad_4 / rHess_44) * rMPCStepSize;
ELSE
    bMPC_IllConditioned := TRUE;
    dwAlarmWord_2 := dwAlarmWord_2 OR 16#0001_0000; (* MPC Ill-Conditioned Warning *)
    rDelta_u1_FeedFlow   := 0.0;
    rDelta_u2_EluentFlow := 0.0;
    rDelta_u3_StepTime   := 0.0;
    rDelta_u4_BufferB    := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Slew Rate Clamping *)
IF rDelta_u1_FeedFlow > 3.0 THEN rDelta_u1_FeedFlow := 3.0; END_IF;
IF rDelta_u1_FeedFlow < -3.0 THEN rDelta_u1_FeedFlow := -3.0; END_IF;
IF rDelta_u2_EluentFlow > 2.0 THEN rDelta_u2_EluentFlow := 2.0; END_IF;
IF rDelta_u2_EluentFlow < -2.0 THEN rDelta_u2_EluentFlow := -2.0; END_IF;
IF rDelta_u3_StepTime > 15.0 THEN rDelta_u3_StepTime := 15.0; END_IF;
IF rDelta_u3_StepTime < -15.0 THEN rDelta_u3_StepTime := -15.0; END_IF;

(* ===================================================================================== *)
(* 7.0 MULTI-PORT ROTARY VALVE STEP-TIME FLUID SYNCHRONIZATION ENGINE                    *)
(* ===================================================================================== *)
(* Execute Commutation Sequence at Step-Time Expiration *)
rEncoderError_deg := ABS(rRotaryValvePos_Sens_deg - rTargetAngleInternal_deg);

(* Stall Watchdog Timer: Trigger if valve is in motion for > 6.0 s without reaching target *)
tonValveStallTimer(IN := bValveInMotion, PT := T#6000MS);
IF tonValveStallTimer.Q THEN
    dwAlarmWord_1 := dwAlarmWord_1 OR 16#0000_0040; (* Rotary Valve Actuator Stall Alarm *)
    iState := 99; (* Emergency Park *)
END_IF;

CASE iValveStepSubState OF
    0: (* DORMANT: Waiting for Step-Timer Expiration *)
        bValveInMotion          := FALSE;
        rRotaryValveSpeed_deg_s := 0.0;
        IF (rCycleTimer_s >= rAdaptedStepTime_s) AND (iState = 40) THEN
            iValveStepSubState  := 1; (* Initiate Smooth Deceleration *)
            rValveSubTimer_s    := 0.0;
        END_IF;

    1: (* PHASE A: Hydraulic Deceleration to 20% Flow (Prevent Water Hammer) *)
        bValveInMotion          := FALSE;
        rValveSubTimer_s        := rValveSubTimer_s + (tScanCycleTime_ms / 1000.0);
        IF rValveSubTimer_s >= 1.20 THEN
            (* Target next indexed discrete angle (8 columns = 45.0 degrees per index) *)
            iCurrentPortIndex       := (iCurrentPortIndex + 1) MOD 8;
            rTargetAngleInternal_deg:= DINT_TO_REAL(iCurrentPortIndex) * 45.0;
            iValveStepSubState      := 2; (* Advance Rotary Actuator *)
            rValveSubTimer_s        := 0.0;
            bValveInMotion          := TRUE;
        END_IF;

    2: (* PHASE B & C: High-Precision Servo Rotation Across Shear Face *)
        rRotaryValveSpeed_deg_s := rValveNominalSpeed_deg_s;
        rValveSubTimer_s        := rValveSubTimer_s + (tScanCycleTime_ms / 1000.0);
        (* Confirm Optical Encoder Alignment within +/- 0.35 degrees *)
        IF (rEncoderError_deg <= 0.35) OR (rValveSubTimer_s >= 2.0) THEN
            rRotaryValveSpeed_deg_s := 0.0;
            bValveInMotion          := FALSE;
            iValveStepSubState      := 3; (* Seal Settling & Pressure Equalization *)
            rValveSubTimer_s        := 0.0;
        END_IF;

    3: (* PHASE D: Seal Settling, Column Advance & Soft Flow Re-pressurization *)
        rValveSubTimer_s        := rValveSubTimer_s + (tScanCycleTime_ms / 1000.0);
        IF rValveSubTimer_s >= 0.80 THEN
            (* Advance Lead Column Index [1..8] *)
            iCurrentColumnLead      := (iCurrentColumnLead MOD 8) + 1;
            iTotalCompletedCycles   := iTotalCompletedCycles + 1;
            (* Reset Cycle Metrics for New Column *)
            rCycleTimer_s           := 0.0;
            rCumulativeFeedVolume_mL:= 0.0;
            rCumulativeMassLoaded_mg:= 0.0;
            rBreakthroughFront_mm   := 0.0;
            iValveStepSubState      := 0; (* Return to Dormant *)
        END_IF;
END_CASE;

rTargetRotaryAngle_deg := rTargetAngleInternal_deg;

(* ===================================================================================== *)
(* 8.0 SIMULATED MOVING BED FINITE STATE MACHINE (FSM) EXECUTION                         *)
(* ===================================================================================== *)
(* Accumulate timers *)
rStateTimer_s := rStateTimer_s + (tScanCycleTime_ms / 1000.0);
IF iState = 40 THEN
    rCycleTimer_s := rCycleTimer_s + (tScanCycleTime_ms / 1000.0);
END_IF;

CASE iState OF
    0: (* STATE 0: BOOT INITIALIZATION & POWER-ON SELF-TEST (POST) *)
        bSystemReady            := FALSE;
        bActiveElutionCut       := FALSE;
        bActiveRecycleCut       := FALSE;
        rFeedPumpCmd_mLmin      := 0.0;
        rEluentPumpCmd_mLmin    := 0.0;
        rWashPumpCmd_mLmin      := 0.0;
        rCIPPumpCmd_mLmin       := 0.0;
        rRotaryValveSpeed_deg_s := 0.0;
        iValveStepSubState      := 0;
        iCurrentPortIndex       := 0;
        rTargetAngleInternal_deg:= 0.0;
        IF bEnableSystem AND (rStateTimer_s >= 2.0) THEN
            iState              := 10; (* Transition to PRIMING & DEGASSING *)
            rStateTimer_s       := 0.0;

    10: (* STATE 10: FLUIDIC PRIMING & DE-AIRING *)
        bSystemReady            := FALSE;
        (* Ramp Wash pump to prime manifolds and displace micro-bubbles *)
        rWashPumpCmd_mLmin      := 35.0;
        rFeedPumpCmd_mLmin      := 0.0;
        rEluentPumpCmd_mLmin    := 0.0;
        rCIPPumpCmd_mLmin       := 0.0;
        IF rStateTimer_s >= 30.0 THEN
            rWashPumpCmd_mLmin  := 0.0;
            iState              := 20; (* Transition to BED INTEGRITY QUALIFICATION *)
            rStateTimer_s       := 0.0;
        END_IF;

    20: (* STATE 20: RESIN BED INTEGRITY QUALIFICATION (HETP & ASYMMETRY CHECK) *)
        bSystemReady            := FALSE;
        (* Operate at nominal mobile phase velocity (150 cm/h) and check Darcy permeability *)
        rWashPumpCmd_mLmin      := (150.0 * rColumnCrossSection_cm2) / 60.0;
        IF rStateTimer_s >= 20.0 THEN
            IF bBedCompactionWarning THEN
                dwAlarmWord_3   := dwAlarmWord_3 OR 16#0000_0004; (* Qualification HETP Fail *)
            END_IF;
            rWashPumpCmd_mLmin  := 0.0;
            iState              := 30; (* Transition to EQUILIBRATION & BUFFER BALANCE *)
            rStateTimer_s       := 0.0;
        END_IF;

    30: (* STATE 30: PRE-EQUILIBRATION & ZONE BUFFER CONDITIONING *)
        bSystemReady            := FALSE;
        (* Pump Equilibration Buffer A across all zones until conductivity stabilizes at 18.5 +/- 0.5 mS/cm *)
        rWashPumpCmd_mLmin      := 45.0;
        rEluentPumpCmd_mLmin    := 25.0;
        IF (rStateTimer_s >= 45.0) AND (ABS(rFilteredCond_mScm - 18.5) < 1.2) THEN
            rWashPumpCmd_mLmin  := 0.0;
            rEluentPumpCmd_mLmin:= 0.0;
            iState              := 40; (* ENTER STEADY-STATE CONTINUOUS SMB OPERATION *)
            rStateTimer_s       := 0.0;
            rCycleTimer_s       := 0.0;
        END_IF;

    40: (* STATE 40: CONTINUOUS SMB STEADY-STATE PRODUCTION (COORDINATED 4-ZONE CAPTURE) *)
        bSystemReady            := TRUE;
        (* Modulate Pump Setpoints via MPC Optimization *)
        IF NOT bDegradedControlActive THEN
            (* Active MPC Modulated Commands *)
            rFeedPumpCmd_mLmin   := 65.0 + rDelta_u1_FeedFlow;
            rEluentPumpCmd_mLmin := 38.0 + rDelta_u2_EluentFlow;
            rWashPumpCmd_mLmin   := 28.0;
            rCIPPumpCmd_mLmin    := 0.0;
        ELSE
            (* Fallback Decoupled Proportional Feedback Control *)
            rFeedPumpCmd_mLmin   := 55.0 - (1.2 * x3_DeltaPressErr_bar);
            rEluentPumpCmd_mLmin := 32.0;
            rWashPumpCmd_mLmin   := 24.0;
            rCIPPumpCmd_mLmin    := 0.0;
        END_IF;

        (* Throttle during rotary valve commutation *)
        IF iValveStepSubState = 1 THEN
            rFeedPumpCmd_mLmin   := rFeedPumpCmd_mLmin * rValveFlowDecelFactor;
            rEluentPumpCmd_mLmin := rEluentPumpCmd_mLmin * rValveFlowDecelFactor;
            rWashPumpCmd_mLmin   := rWashPumpCmd_mLmin * rValveFlowDecelFactor;
        ELSIF (iValveStepSubState = 2) OR (iValveStepSubState = 3) THEN
            rFeedPumpCmd_mLmin   := rFeedPumpCmd_mLmin * 0.15;
            rEluentPumpCmd_mLmin := rEluentPumpCmd_mLmin * 0.15;
            rWashPumpCmd_mLmin   := rWashPumpCmd_mLmin * 0.15;
        END_IF;

        (* Saturation Clamping on Final Actuator Setpoints *)
        IF rFeedPumpCmd_mLmin > rFeedFlow_Max_mLmin THEN rFeedPumpCmd_mLmin := rFeedFlow_Max_mLmin; END_IF;
        IF rFeedPumpCmd_mLmin < rFeedFlow_Min_mLmin THEN rFeedPumpCmd_mLmin := rFeedFlow_Min_mLmin; END_IF;
        IF rEluentPumpCmd_mLmin > rEluentFlow_Max_mLmin THEN rEluentPumpCmd_mLmin := rEluentFlow_Max_mLmin; END_IF;
        IF rEluentPumpCmd_mLmin < rEluentFlow_Min_mLmin THEN rEluentPumpCmd_mLmin := rEluentFlow_Min_mLmin; END_IF;

        IF NOT bEnableSystem THEN
            iState              := 90; (* Orderly System Shutdown *)
            rStateTimer_s       := 0.0;
        END_IF;

    70: (* STATE 70: RESIN CIP CAUSTIC SANITIZATION & STRIP REGENERATION *)
        bSystemReady            := FALSE;
        bActiveElutionCut       := FALSE;
        bActiveRecycleCut       := FALSE;
        rFeedPumpCmd_mLmin      := 0.0;
        rEluentPumpCmd_mLmin    := 0.0;
        rWashPumpCmd_mLmin      := 0.0;
        rCIPPumpCmd_mLmin       := 30.0; (* 0.1M - 0.5M NaOH Sanitization Flow *)
        IF rStateTimer_s >= 900.0 THEN (* 15.0 minute caustic contact time *)
            rCIPPumpCmd_mLmin   := 0.0;
            iState              := 30; (* Return to Pre-Equilibration *)
            rStateTimer_s       := 0.0;
        END_IF;

    90: (* STATE 90: CONTROLLED SHUTDOWN & PRESERVATION (20% ETHANOL FLUSH) *)
        bSystemReady            := FALSE;
        bActiveElutionCut       := FALSE;
        bActiveRecycleCut       := FALSE;
        rFeedPumpCmd_mLmin      := 0.0;
        rEluentPumpCmd_mLmin    := 0.0;
        rWashPumpCmd_mLmin      := 25.0; (* Flush storage solution *)
        rCIPPumpCmd_mLmin       := 0.0;
        IF rStateTimer_s >= 180.0 THEN
            rWashPumpCmd_mLmin  := 0.0;
            iState              := 0; (* System Parked *)
            rStateTimer_s       := 0.0;
        END_IF;

    99: (* STATE 99: EMERGENCY SAFE ISOLATION / HARDWARE PARK *)
        bSystemReady            := FALSE;
        bActiveElutionCut       := FALSE;
        bActiveRecycleCut       := FALSE;
        rFeedPumpCmd_mLmin      := 0.0;
        rEluentPumpCmd_mLmin    := 0.0;
        rWashPumpCmd_mLmin      := 0.0;
        rCIPPumpCmd_mLmin       := 0.0;
        rRotaryValveSpeed_deg_s := 0.0;
        (* Lock in State 99 until bEmergencyStop is restored and bResetFaults is pulsed *)
        IF bEmergencyStop AND bResetFaults THEN
            iState              := 0;
            rStateTimer_s       := 0.0;
        END_IF;

    ELSE
        iState                  := 99;
END_CASE;
